item.title: Rallying Cry – October 11, 2026
item.description: From groundbreaking medical advancements like Efferon's fight against pediatric sepsis to celebrating creativity with CRÉATION AFRICA, plus thousands rallying for climate action in Brussels and a new mental health center opening in Singapore, today's news is full of hope and progress!
